procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (46 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side 1-48 in order, no repeats or gaps. Answer side 1-25, match block (heading printed '25.Match the following' — stray label, the block answers q026), 27-47 (keys 40 and 42 are numbered lists 1-3); q048 no key. Difficulty per question: easy 36, average 4, difficult 8, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 94 (heading, LO 7 bullets, q1-5) 95-97; A pdf 188-191.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following with appropriate answers (easy)' q26 (6 rows); s5 one mark q27-34 vsa; s6 two marks q35-39 sa; s7 three marks q40-43 sa; s8 four marks q44-48 la.
MCQ q1-q3 print lower-case option labels (a) b) c) …) on one line — options set by hand (ids A-D). q36 and q43 tags '(hard)' -> difficult (word map).
Keys 40 and 42 print numbered lists '1. 2. 3.' — one step each; key 25 on the match heading is a stray label (key side), not a shift.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_23.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
